{{Quote|Hear it howl, for it was bred to scream, blood and fibers woven into a devouring beast. It was Gharj whose claws scored the canals of Seylott; Gharj who consumed the natives of Alzoc, and was worshiped for it. Gharj whom the alchemists of a younger age sought to emulate, but all would fail. Look upon Gharj, and die.|Soa|<ref name="Vault" />}}
'''Gharj''' was a monstrous [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]]-like creature that had been created by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] through [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Force alchemy]]. During the era of the Empire, it was unleashed upon numerous worlds; the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Soa]] claimed that Gharj's claws had carved the canals of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seylott/Legends|Seylott]], and Gharj's attacks on the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] of [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]] led the Talz to worship the Rakata. It was imprisoned along with Soa and his forces in the [[Eternity Vault]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], and was [[Death/Legends|slain]] when the Vault was breached during the [[Galactic War]] and Soa attempted to break free.

==Behind the scenes==
Gharj is the second boss in the Eternity Vault operation featured in the [[2011]] [[LucasArts]] and [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
